attractions.name: Tashkent City Park
attractions.description: Contemporary urban park with landscaped gardens, a lake promenade, fountains, cafés and entertainment areas.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: WWII Memorial
attractions.description: Memorial honoring Uzbek soldiers who fought in World War II, with landscaped gardens, sculptures and memorial halls.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Independence Square (Mustaqillik Maydoni)
attractions.description: Symbol of the country's sovereignty, with marble walkways, fountains and gardens; monuments and fountains light up at sunset.
tips: Don't miss the Independence Arch and the golden globe monument
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Hazrati Imam Complex
attractions.description: One of the most important Islamic centers in Uzbekistan in the Old Town, with madrasas, mosques and courtyards featuring turquoise domes and tile work.
tips: Visit early in the morning for a peaceful atmosphere and soft light
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Muyi Muborak Madrasah
attractions.description: Madrasa within the Hazrat Imam complex that houses the Uthman Quran, believed to be one of the oldest Qurans in existence.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Tillya Sheikh Mosque
attractions.description: Active place of worship in the Hazrat Imam complex with elegant Islamic architecture and a tranquil courtyard.
attractions.dress_code: Modest clothing, shoulders and knees covered
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri Memorial
attractions.description: Site reflecting the historical ties between India and Uzbekistan.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Broadway Street
attractions.description: Lively pedestrian street with cafés, souvenir shops and local artists.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Alisher Navoi Opera & Ballet Theatre
attractions.description: Soviet-era architectural landmark and important cultural venue.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Amir Temur Square
attractions.description: One of the city's most iconic squares, dedicated to the ruler Amir Temur.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Magic City Park
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Seoul Mun Street
attractions.description: Modern stretch known for cafés and a relaxed urban atmosphere.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Monument of Courage
attractions.description: Memorial dedicated to the resilience of Tashkent after the 1966 earthquake.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Memorial to the Victims of Repression
attractions.description: Memorial reflecting an important chapter in Uzbekistan's history.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Tashkent TV Tower
attractions.description: Iconic landmark and one of the tallest structures in Central Asia; good photo stop.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Hoja Ahror Juma Mosque
attractions.description: Friday Mosque dating to the 15th century with domes, arches and prayer courtyards; still an important religious site for locals.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Chorsu Bazaar
attractions.description: One of Tashkent's oldest and most colorful markets in a massive turquoise-domed building, selling spices, dried fruits, nuts, produce, bread and sweets.
tips: Be mindful of pickpockets in crowds
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Tashkent City Mall
attractions.description: Modern shopping mall with international brands, cafés and restaurants.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Chorsu Bozor (Chorsu Bazaar)
attractions.description: Located in the heart of the old city, Chorsu Bazaar is one of Tashkent's oldest and most colorful markets

local_dishes.name: Plov (Uzbek Pilaf)
local_dishes.description: National dish of Uzbekistan: fragrant rice cooked with carrots, onions, spices and usually lamb or chicken; every region has its own variation and it is traditionally served at celebrations.
local_dishes._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

local_dishes.name: Manti
local_dishes.description: Large steamed dumplings typically filled with minced meat and onions; pumpkin or potato versions are sometimes available.
local_dishes._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

local_dishes.name: Samsa
local_dishes.description: Popular street snack of flaky baked pastry filled with meat, pumpkin or vegetables, traditionally cooked in a tandoor.
local_dishes._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

local_dishes.name: Lagman
local_dishes.description: Comforting noodle dish with hand-pulled noodles, vegetables, and a rich broth or stir-fry sauce.
local_dishes._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

local_dishes.name: Shashlik
local_dishes.description: Skewered grilled meat kebabs typically served with fresh onions and flatbread; one of the most widely available dishes in Central Asia.
local_dishes._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

local_dishes.name: Non (Uzbek Bread)
local_dishes._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx
